alternativePayment.title: Can't use Dodo Payments?
alternativePayment.description: Dodo Payments isn't available in every country, and in some regions it only supports credit cards. If you can't use Dodo Payments in your country (or you need a non-card option), you can pay through one of these instead:
alternativePayment.step1: Pay for the number of months you want to subscribe, using the plan's monthly price. For example, six months cost (monthly price) × 6.
alternativePayment.step2: your account email, the plan and number of months, and proof of payment — your GitHub Sponsors receipt, or your PayPal email address / transaction ID if you paid via PayPal.
alternativePayment.step3: We'll manually enable your plan from our backend for the number of months you paid for, and it will auto-expire after that period.
alternativePayment.note: since these payments aren't processed through our automated checkout, we enable plans manually and it can take up to 72 hours. To avoid a gap in service, we recommend prepaying at least 3–6 months at a time.

automationUrl.label: Automation URL
automationUrl.description: The page address this automation is allowed to run on. URL Match Type controls whether it is compared exactly or as a pattern.

waitBeforeStart.label: Wait Before Start
waitBeforeStart.description: How long the automation waits after its start event before running the first step. A range chooses a random delay between the two values.

stepDelay.label: Step Delay
stepDelay.description: How long to wait before running this step. A range chooses a random delay between the two values.

stepName.label: Step Name
stepName.description: An optional name that helps you recognize this step in the editor, logs, guards, and Go to Step lists.

target.label: Target
target.description: The page item this step acts on, identified with a CSS selector, XPath, element ID, position, or another supported finder.

value.label: Value
value.description: What the step does with its target, such as text to enter, a click command, a placeholder, or another supported value command.

placeholder.label: Placeholder
placeholder.description: A token inside a Value that is replaced when the automation runs, such as a batch number, random value, clipboard text, or data from another source.

stepRepeat.label: Step Repeat
stepRepeat.description: How many additional times this individual step runs before the automation moves to the next step.

stepInterval.label: Step Interval
stepInterval.description: How long to wait between repeats of this individual step. A range chooses a random wait each time.

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Runs the entire automation again after all of its steps finish. This is different from Repeat, which repeats only one step.

batch.label: Batch
batch.description: The older name for an automation Loop. The legacy batchRepeat placeholder is the same as loopRepeat, which contains the current loop number.

loopRefresh.label: Loop Refresh
loopRefresh.description: Reloads the page after all steps finish. The automation can start again after the refreshed page loads.

loopRepeat.label: Loop Repeat
loopRepeat.description: How many times to run all steps again without reloading the page.

loopInterval.label: Loop Interval
loopInterval.description: How long to wait between complete automation runs. A range chooses a random wait for each loop.

pageGuard.label: Page Guard
pageGuard.description: Checks a value on the current page before a step runs. The step runs only when the configured comparison succeeds.

guardTarget.label: Page Guard Target
guardTarget.description: The page item whose text, value, checked state, or attribute is tested before the step runs.

guardCondition.label: Page Guard Comparison
guardCondition.description: The rule used to compare the value found on the page with Compare With, such as Equals, Contains, or Greater Than.

guardValue.label: Compare With
guardValue.description: The expected value used by the Page Guard comparison. The guarded step runs when the comparison succeeds.

valueExtractor.label: Value Extractor
valueExtractor.description: An optional attribute selector or regular expression that extracts only the part of the page value you want to compare.

guardRecheck.label: Check Again
guardRecheck.description: How many additional times Page Guard checks the condition when it is not yet met. Unlimited keeps checking until it succeeds or the automation stops.

guardRecheckInterval.label: Guard Recheck Interval
guardRecheckInterval.description: How long Page Guard waits before checking the page condition again. A range chooses a random wait each time.

conditionGuard.label: Condition Guard
conditionGuard.description: Controls whether this step runs based on the result of one or more previous steps. This is also called a Step Guard.

guardOperator.label: Condition Operator
guardOperator.description: Combines guard rules. AND requires this rule and the previous rule to match; OR allows either rule to match.

previousStep.label: Previous Step
previousStep.description: The earlier step whose completion result is checked by this Condition Guard.

stepResult.label: Step Result
stepResult.description: The outcome the selected previous step must have, such as completed or error, for this guard rule to match.

stepSettings.label: Step Settings
stepSettings.description: Overrides retry and embedded-page behavior for this step only, without changing the defaults used by other steps.

embeddedPages.label: Embedded Pages
embeddedPages.description: Frames embedded inside the current page, commonly called iframes. Enabling this searches those frames before the main page.

retryAttempts.label: Retry Attempts
retryAttempts.description: How many additional times to look for a missing target before applying the selected failure action.

retryInterval.label: Retry Interval
retryInterval.description: How long to wait before looking for a missing target again. A range chooses a random wait for each retry.

runMode.label: Run Mode
runMode.description: Controls whether an automation starts automatically from page events or manually when you press its hotkey.

hotkey.label: Hotkey
hotkey.description: A keyboard shortcut that starts this automation when its Run Mode is Manual.

pageLoadTiming.label: Page Load Timing
pageLoadTiming.description: Chooses which browser page event starts an automatic automation: when the document is ready or after the full page finishes loading.

pageNavigation.label: Page Navigation
pageNavigation.description: Runs the automation when a site changes its URL without fully reloading the page, as many single-page applications do.

googleSheetsId.label: Google Sheets ID
googleSheetsId.description: The unique part of a Google Sheets URL that identifies the spreadsheet used by Google Sheets Value commands.

startTime.label: Start Time
startTime.description: A time of day in HH:mm:ss.sss format that limits when the automation may start.

urlMatchType.label: URL Match Type
urlMatchType.description: Controls how the Automation URL is compared: Exact URL requires the same address, while Pattern Match accepts a regular-expression pattern.

bypassHotkeys.label: Bypass Browser Hotkey Behavior
bypassHotkeys.description: Prevents matching alert, confirm, or prompt dialogs from taking over the configured automation hotkey.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.description: Starts an automation at the configured date and time instead of relying only on page load or a manual hotkey.

scheduleRepeat.label: Schedule Repeat
scheduleRepeat.description: How many minutes to wait before starting the scheduled automation again.

monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.description: Watches part of a page for newly added or changed matching items and runs the automation again when changes are detected.

monitorRoot.label: Monitor Root
monitorRoot.description: The CSS selector for the page container to watch. Using a narrow container avoids reacting to unrelated page changes.

monitorAttributes.label: Monitor Attributes
monitorAttributes.description: A comma-separated list of element attributes whose changes should trigger monitoring, such as class, style, or hidden.

debounce.label: Debounce
debounce.description: Waits for rapid page changes to settle before processing them, so a burst of updates triggers one automation run instead of many.

monitorTimeout.label: Monitor Timeout
monitorTimeout.description: Automatically stops monitoring after this many minutes so the automation does not watch the page indefinitely.

monitorUrlChange.label: Stop on URL Change
monitorUrlChange.description: Stops the active monitor when the page address changes, preventing it from carrying over to a different view.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.enabledHint: Automatically re-run actions when new matching elements are added to the page (e.g., for infinite scrolling, async content)
monitor.rootSelectorHint: CSS selector for container to observe
monitor.attributesHint: Comma-separated list of attributes to observe for changes
monitor.debounceHint: Delay before processing new elements (1-5 seconds)
monitor.urlChangeHint: Automatically stop watching when page URL changes

home.title: Welcome to Auto Clicker - AutoFill
home.subtitle: Automate clicks and form fills on any website by defining targets and actions.

step1.title: 1. Install the Extension
step1.desc: Download and install the extension from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons.

step2.title: 2. Configure a Target Page
step2.desc: Open a web page, right-click any element and choose Auto Clicker - AutoFill → Configure for this Field.

step3.title: 3. Save & Run
step3.desc: Save your configuration and reload the target page. The automation runs automatically.

tip1.title: Try on the Test Page
tip1.desc: Open test.getautoclicker.com, add two actions — one to fill a username field and one to click a button — then save and run.

tip2.title: Target Items Precisely
tip2.desc: Use element paths to target specific items on a page, like //input[@name="username"], for more reliable automation.

tip3.title: Handle Slow Page Loads
tip3.desc: Set a Wait Before Start on your automation if the page loads slowly before your steps run.

tip4.title: Global Settings & Hotkeys
tip4.desc: Configure start mode, define a keyboard shortcut, and adjust the status bar position in Global Settings.

tip5.title: Right-click to Auto-Capture
tip5.desc: Right-click any input or button on a page and select Configure for this Field to auto-fill the URL and Element Finder.
